bilingual.notes: 92 NAC 24 §006.09 Bilingual Education endorsement (PK-12 / PK-6 / 7-12). Supplemental endorsement that requires the holder to also hold (or earn concurrently) an ESL endorsement plus a subject or field endorsement. Rule 24 mandates a minimum of 12 semester hours of methodology, content instruction, and content literacy in bilingual education programs, of which 9 hours must be taught in the target language, plus a 45-clock-hour practicum in a bilingual education program taught in the target language. The June 2024 Rule 24 Guidelines further set ACTFL Advanced-Low target-language proficiency as Standard 1. Both an approved educator-preparation program (Rule 20) and a Praxis content-test add-on pathway are available.

eld.notes: 92 NAC 24 §006.23 English As A Second Language endorsement (PK-12 / PK-6 / 7-12), Supplemental only — no standalone ESL/TESOL license. Rule 24 mandates 15 semester hours across Second Language Acquisition, English Language/Linguistics, Cross-Cultural Communication, Methods/Curriculum Design in ESL, and Assessment and Evaluation of ELLs, plus a 45-clock-hour practicum with ELL students. June 2024 Rule 24 Guidelines align the endorsement to TESOL standards. Per the NDE Educator Certification announcement of June 4, 2025, applicants who complete an approved educator preparation program are no longer required to pass the Praxis content test; a Praxis-test add-on pathway remains available for adding the endorsement. ESL is a prerequisite for the Bilingual Education endorsement.

history.title: EPAA 29(100) document analysis (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Leider, Colombo & Nerlino published in Education Policy Analysis Archives 29(100) a comprehensive document analysis of every state and DC's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI teacher-credentialing requirements, professional teaching standards mentions, and EL-percentage figures, based on primary SEA sources collected October–December 2019. The 2019 coding of Nebraska's EL-credentialing landscape is preserved as a temporally-anchored research baseline against which the catalog's later verifications are framed.

history.title: Nebraska Seal of Biliteracy adopted (LB 1042)
history.description: Nebraska Seal of Biliteracy authorized by LB 1042 (2020) and codified at Neb. Rev. Stat. §79-769; administered by NDE World Languages. Recognizes graduates who demonstrate proficiency in English and at least one additional language.

history.title: Rule 24 (92 NAC 24) endorsement framework readopted
history.description: NDE readopted Rule 24 effective 2024-06-02, refreshing the Bilingual Education (§006.09) and English As A Second Language (§006.23) endorsement specifications. Companion Rule 24 Guidelines (June 2024) align ESL to TESOL standards and set ACTFL Advanced-Low as the bilingual target-language proficiency floor.

history.title: Praxis content-test waiver for approved-program completers
history.description: NDE Educator Certification announced that effective June 4, 2025 candidates completing an approved Nebraska educator-preparation program no longer need to pass the Praxis content test for endorsement; a Praxis-test add-on pathway remains available for adding endorsements without an approved program. Reflected in eld.requirements.test=false (program completers' default path).
